text:
marie: Quick heads-up for this release train: rolling changes to gating and observability. please ack.

marie: High level: introduce a soft-freeze tag, add per-model "heat" telemetry to canary dashboards, and require perf-check and smoke-run before flipping. Canary window moved to Fri 22:00-02:00 UTC (overnight local) for this sprint only.

marie: Soft-freeze meaning: non-urgent feature merges should be marked `release:soft-freeze` and held until after the canary completes. Ops-only hotfixes can go through with release + ops signoff.

dave: Ack. Where do we see the new "heat" metric?

marie: Dashboards: https://redwood.internal/dashboards/canary-heat (eng-release & eng-sre access). Heat is a composite of token load + concurrent KV cache pressure. Use it to decide staged ramps.

oleg: We have a big quant-plugin bump in this train. Any change to rollback policy?

emily: If quant plugin touches runtime kernels, require a two-hour minimum canary and a quick perf snapshot comparing P50/95 and memory delta. If regressions >15% on P95 or memory +10%, automatic rollback.

ops-bot: smoke pipeline updated for train-1765: added `check:canary-smoke`, `check:heat-threshold`, and `check:quant-sanity`. :white_check_mark: 

marie: Checklist (short):
- run `make release-smoke` locally or via CI
- confirm heat < baseline + 8%
- P95 <= baseline * 1.15 (15% headroom only for heavy-token models)
- PRs that must wait: add `release:soft-freeze` label

oleg: Noted. For migrations that touch schema we should avoid starting them inside the freeze window, right?

emily: Correct. No migrations within 12h of freeze start unless emergency. Put migration plan in the PR and tag eng-sre for review.

dave: small ask: can we add a one-line canary flip status to the release thread? makes it easier for oncall to scan.

marie: Yes, please post a single-line when you flip: `canary: id=<id> | up|down | t=10m | p95=xxxms | heat=yy%`.

release-bot: Note: reverting to previous gating policy requires documented approval from release leads and security. See /policies/release-management.

oleg: I hit a tokenizer mismatch in local regression; cutting a hotfix PR now.

emily: If you need extended canary for heavy-token services, request a staged ramp in the thread and include expected token rate. Eng-sre will coordinate.

ops-bot: emergency opt-out CLI available:
```n/release optout --policy gating --reason "urgent-fix" --approver @ops-team
```
(approver ack required; audit logged)

marie: action items:
- eng owners: apply `release:soft-freeze` where needed and run smoke
- eng-sre: watch heat & auto-rollback thresholds, be ready during Fri window
- release leads: approve exceptions with mitigation in-thread

emily: smoke passed for PR #5012, canary candidate uploaded. posting brief when flip happens.

marie: thanks all. I'll publish a one-paragraph changelog tomorrow with canary outcome and any rollbacks. ping @marie or escalate in #eng-oncall if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
